rows.en: This test assesses your aptitude as a test pilot for Project Super Nova, the next main VF contest. Win the mock battle against the Valkyrie squad.

Collect as many of the targets placed
around the area as you can.
A flight test of the prototype's thrust, mobility and flight performance begins. Collect more of the area's targets than the rival model.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Destroy the targets as you
head for the target area at speed.
To test the prototype's agility, we'll fly it in a confined space like a base. Run a time trial: destroy all targets and reach the target area.

Destroy as many enemies as you can
within the 5-minute time limit.
To gauge the prototype's combat ability, we'll now stage an arena mock battle. Battle a large number of targets, simulating combat against multiple enemies.

Stop the bombers escorted by VF-11s
from reaching the target area.
For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock air battle now begins. Destroy the VF-11 and drone-escorted bombers short of the target area.
Defeat the rival aircraft in the competition.
For head-to-head prototype data, we now hold a mock battle against the rival. Needless to say, it's the most crucial test for selection. Win at any cost.

Destroy the auto-defense satellite
and descend to Earth amid its debris.
U.N. soldiers have run amok in Macross City during the memorial ceremony. Destroy the orbital auto-defense satellite and descend amid its debris.
rows.notes: The ceremony (kinen shikiten) is the commemoration in Macross City (Macross Plus finale); 'run amok' for bousou (the soldiers are under Sharon's control). Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Intercept the YF-21
alongside the YF-19.
The joy of reaching Earth is short-lived: the YF-21 is blocking your path. There's no more time to waste. Intercept the YF-21 alongside the YF-19.

To stop Sharon's rampage,
destroy Sharon immediately.
Sharon Apple has run out of control and seized U.N. Forces central command. To free the people her song is manipulating, destroy Sharon immediately.
Wipe out the unknowns that just appeared.
A vanguard craft reports to Battle 7 a surprise attack by an unknown force. Annihilate the unknown units to keep them off the Macross 7 fleet.
rows.notes: zenei-tei = a small vanguard craft of the fleet. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
As part of training,
fight a mock battle against Gamlin.
Danger always lurks on a journey through vast space. To prepare for the worst, beat Diamond Force member Lt. Gamlin Kizaki in a training mock battle.

Recover the containers holding citizens
and annihilate the Varauta Army.
Citizens kidnapped by the Varauta Army are being carried off in containers. Annihilate the Varauta escort and bring the containers to the designated area.

Retake the fold generator, then defend
it and annihilate the Varauta Army.
The Varauta Army is trying to re-fold City 7, now cut off from Battle 7. Retake the generator, annihilate the Varauta Army and stop the re-fold.

Protect as many civilian craft as
possible while wiping out the Varauta Army.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: The Varauta Army suddenly appeared during the crowded Battroid Carnival. Keep citizens safe: guard the Monsters while annihilating the Varauta Army.

To protect the citizens of City 7,
annihilate the Varauta Army.
Battle 7's relief escorts were wiped out instantly by a mysterious Varauta foe. Annihilate the Varauta Army to protect the citizens of City 7.

Annihilate the Varauta Army that's
blocking the escape from the blazing star.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: City 7 is being pulled toward a blazing star, and the Varauta Army has struck amid the crisis. Annihilate the Varauta Army and escape the star.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Annihilate the Varauta Army, which has
launched a large-scale attack.
Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet. Sink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.

Destroy the Protodeviln,
or survive for 5 minutes.
We've spotted a likely Protodeviln, approx. 300 m long, unlike any foe so far. Make survival your top priority, and destroy the Protodeviln if possible.

Stop the Protodeviln coming to save
their comrade from reaching the target area.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: We captured a Protodeviln, but let its would-be rescuers break into Battle 7. Annihilate the intruders and stop them from seizing the Protodeviln.
Annihilate the Varauta Army.
The Protodeviln have gotten serious and are attacking the Macross 7 fleet. We can't let the Protodeviln beat us here. Annihilate the Varauta Army.

As part of training,
fight a mock battle with the legendary duo.
Ahead of the escalating Protodeviln war, a mock battle will now be held. Beat the married duo: a genius pilot of old in the latest model, and an ex-ace.

Annihilate the Varauta Army to carry
out Operation Stargazer.
We now launch Operation Stargazer, a surprise assault by a small elite force. Wipe out the Varauta Army at all costs to fire reaction weapons into the cave.

Shoot down Gamlin, who is being
controlled by the Protodeviln.
Capt. Gamlin, possessed by the Protodeviln, is on a rampage, wrecking bases. We can't allow more damage. You're authorized to shoot down Capt. Gamlin.

To protect the peace of the galaxy,
destroy Gepelnitchi.
To thwart Gepelnitchi's ambition, the "Spiritia Farm Project," and to protect galactic peace, destroy Varauta Army commander Gepelnitchi.

Annihilate the rogue Meltrandi fleet
that has launched an attack.
A vanguard ship has been wiped out by a large rogue Meltrandi fleet. They mustn't get any closer to the Macross 7 fleet. Annihilate the rogue fleet.

Arrest the poachers trying
to poach the Galaxy Whales.
Galaxy Whales are nearing orbit; we've detected likely poachers hunting them. Arrest them once confirmed. You may ignore the civilian craft also spotted.

As part of training,
fight a mock battle against Patrol officers.
When the Galaxy Whales near Zola, poachers flock to the planet in droves. To prepare, the Zolan Star Patrol holds its regular training: a mock battle.
The Galaxy Whales are nearing Zola again: prime hunting season for poachers. We can't ignore their poaching any longer. Take the poachers into custody.

Escort Officer Liza to the target area
and arrest the poachers.
Undercover with the poachers, Officer Liza is fleeing in a stolen VF-17. Escort her to the target area, then arrest the poachers and black marketeers.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 characters (2 lines).

rows.en:
Protect the Galaxy Whale from the
reaction weapon and arrest the poachers.
Poachers aim a reaction weapon at the white Galaxy Whale hampering their hunt. Protect the whale from the weapon at all costs and arrest the poachers.

To stop them from entering Island 1,
annihilate the unknown lifeforms.
An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to hide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.

As part of training, fight a mock
battle against the New U.N. Forces.
A mock battle now begins as our regular joint drill with the New U.N. Forces. Show them what S.M.S. can really do, and win the mock battle.
Annihilate the Vajra that have reappeared.
The enemy that hit Macross Frontier never left; it lurks in Island 3's base block. Wipe out the Vajra to keep them away from Island 1.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
As part of the S.M.S. applicants' final
test, fight Pixie Team in a mock battle.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: The final test for S.M.S. applicants begins now. To help out, join the applicants in a mock battle against Pixie Team, led by Capt. Klan Klang.

Scout the thieves' hideout, and if they
attack, annihilate the thieves.
The New U.N. Forces have asked us to scout a thieves' hideout. If the thieves attack once you're there, you are authorized to engage them.

As part of training, fight a mock battle
against S.M.S. Skull Squadron.
To prepare for Vajra attacks, a mock battle begins now. Beat Maj. Ozma Lee's Skull Squadron, one of the finest elite units in all of S.M.S.

To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving
ships, wipe out the Vajra.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

Wipe out the Vajra together
with the Macross Quarter.

Jeffrey: "Attention, all units in the field. This ship will now engage the Vajra carrier
          in close-quarters combat. All hands! Transformation!!"
rows.notes: Speaker-label briefing laid out like MUF's shipped Ranka/Sheryl briefings (label, quote, indented second line). 'Vajra carrier' for the Japanese 'Vajra kuubokan' (glossary unit: Carrier-class Vajra). 'All hands!' for zenkan.

rows.en:
Wipe out the Vajra that appeared
while surveying their nest.
We found a Vajra nest and began a survey, aiming to grab a cocoon if possible, but the Vajra spotted us almost at once. Move swiftly to wipe them out.

Quell the Zentradi riot
that broke out on Gallia 4.
A performance crew on a morale tour of planet Gallia 4 has been taken hostage by rioting Zentradi. Put down the riot to rescue them.

Clear out all the Vajra cocoons
aboard the Global.
The Global, 117th Research Fleet flagship found on planet Gallia 4, has become a Vajra lair. To stop the Vajra breeding, clear out every Vajra cocoon aboard.

uncertain: Mission objective rows: several TM lines exceed the per-line estimate as MUF shipped them (widest shipped objective line in the corpus: 274 px); kept.

u2998: Jeffrey's speaker-label briefing written in MUF's speaker layout (label + indented second line) rather than one paragraph; the build re-wrap joins the lines anyway. 'Zenkan! Transformation!!' rendered 'All hands! Transformation!!' (zenkan could also be read 'all ships').
u2937: 'memorial ceremony' assumed to be the Macross City commemoration from Macross Plus.
missing_glossary: automated defense satellite (jidou bouei satellite, Macross Plus) is not in the glossary; written as a common noun.
